records.title: Method of manufacturing load-bearing parts from shredded carbon fibre reinforced composite waste
records.abstract: Production waste of carbon fibre reinforced composite is shredded, the fibres are aligned and re-bonded with a thermoplastic resin in a press. The parts, such as aircraft cabin brackets, reach strength close to virgin composite.

records.title: Radar-based contactless fall detection system for indoor use
records.abstract: A millimetre-wave radar module detects falls from velocity and height of body reflections without recording images.
